h1: Kronplatz ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Kronplatz - Plan de Corones in Italian - is a single broad dome between Bruneck, St. Vigil and Olang, and the operator describes it as a gently sloping mountain with a 360-degree panorama from the top. It carries 31 lifts and 82 slopes, runs from 28 November 2026 to 11 April 2027, and sits on the Dolomiti Superski pass with its 1,200 kilometres.
stayOverview: Three towns ring the mountain and each has its own gondola: Bruneck on the north side with the shops and the railway, Olang to the east, St. Vigil in its own side valley to the south.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Bruneck is the town with most to do in the evening; Olang and St. Vigil are closer to the snow.
rentalCars: Bruneck is on the Pustertal road and railway, about an hour and a half from Bolzano.

baseElevation.unannounced: The operator gives the 2,275 m summit, the piste kilometres and the lift count, but states no altitude for the foot of the mountain on any of its skiing pages.

longestRun.unannounced: The operator gives the 2,275 m summit, over 120 km of pistes and 31 lifts, and names its five black runs, but publishes no run lengths and names no longest run.

dayPass.value: Priced by date in three bands
dayPass.note: Dolomiti Superski prices the day pass by date - early and late-season promo, season, and high season - and publishes the rate only through its own price calculator, with 5% off online two days ahead. Its 2026/27 adult season pass is EUR 990 in advance sale to 24 December and EUR 1,060 after.
